<!-- pr-reviewer: 8b0fcc6a77e062a77d5fa9f7ff528762e85093af -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The scan now keeps the crate directory for paths made with `concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/...")`.
The new test covers library readers, integration readers, deleted fixtures, and an unrelated absolute path.
The existing app and UI reader assertions remain in place.

Results ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2935` against upstream main `81407b3`.
The trial merge reported `Already up to date.` No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed in 247 seconds, zero failures.
- xtask unit tests: 207 passed, including all three regression tests named in the PR body.
- Integration suites: `catalog` 4, `docs_images` 4, `example_line_endings` 1, `merge_ready_skill` 3, `merge_review` 6, `post_merge_concurrency` 1, and `review_artifacts` 3 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: the diff reaches no heavy lane.

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no fixture, golden, or importer file.
Mutations: not run. This process change does not alter posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, or stock simulation.
Goldens moved: none. UI screenshots are not required because no UI file changes.
The local checks used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.
Native Windows execution was not tested.

The PR meets the current upstream process rule. Its body has `Process change: yes`, and it does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Merge class: SAME (no commit after the reviewed head). This merge relies on the review by mkinney with the marker for head `8b0fcc6a77e062a77d5fa9f7ff528762e85093af`.
